विजेता को मिले मतों की संख्या = 54%

हारने वाले को मिले वोटों की संख्या= (100 - 54)% = 46%

प्रश्नानुसार ,

 (x - 96)×(54-46)% = 256

 (x - 96) 8100= 256

x - 96 = 256008  = 3200

x = 3200+96 = 3296

questions_hin.q_hi: In an election between R and S, R gets 110% of the votes of S and beats S by 770 votes. If there were no invalid votes, then the total number of votes polled is:

16170
16710

Solution

Let S got = 100
R got = 110
Difference 10 unit = 770 => 1unit =  = 77
Total no. of votes polled = 100+110=210 unit
=210×77=16170

10.(b)
